weight_status: Explicit workload assumptions, NOT measured user telemetry. Freeze before candidate measurements and report sensitivity; never choose weights after seeing results.
primary_metric: expected_wall_ms = sum(case_weight * mode_weight * request_weight * median_full_request_ms); improvement = 1 - candidate_expected_ms / baseline_expected_ms
absolute_metric: saved seconds per 1000 requests = baseline_expected_ms - candidate_expected_ms
pain_metrics: per-cell absolute delta ms and paired distribution
number and cost of newly crossed 1000 ms boundaries
within_group: Equal weight per admitted case; more tests must not silently increase a group's total weight. Preflight failures are retained and disclosed, never reported as faster compilation.
coverage: Finite representative matrix, not all programs. A missing cell invalidates that profile; no silent renormalization. Explicitly scoped screening matrices may be reported separately.
quality_constraints: same optimization and codegen options in baseline/candidate
native results and error cases checked
changed generated code needs runtime-quality checks; byte-identical emitted LLVM can support a narrower no-codegen-change claim
decision: Do not reject merely because any one case regresses. Require weighted net benefit and meaningful absolute waiting-time savings, report assumption sensitivity, material regressions and severe tails separately. A correctness failure is a hard rejection.
severe_tail_guard: Flag any reproducible per-cell increase exceeding BOTH 2x and 1000 ms; no automatic acceptance until investigated. Lesser regressions are explicitly included in the weighted sum.
sampling: At least seven paired formal histories for final acceptance, one warmup history; alternate or randomize arms; same host and affinity; separate independent compiler/cache outputs. Exploratory profiles are not acceptance timing.
statistics: Report medians plus all raw values, paired wins, bootstrap interval for weighted totals, and median absolute savings. Small-sample maximum is not a stable p95 estimate.
source_sync: Use the pinned new main for both arms; preserve the old candidate and negative results in Git history. No main merge without exact-source verification and review.
